reason: The README describes a DSH Web UI plugin whose primary purpose is handling locally dragged or pasted files and folders as attachment cards or resolved filesystem paths.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中支持拖入或粘贴本地文件、文件夹和图片，并将其作为附件卡片或真实路径插入消息。
summaries.en: Adds DSH Web UI support for dragging or pasting local files, folders, and images as attachment cards or resolved filesystem paths.

capabilities: Intercepts file and folder drag-and-drop or paste events in the DSH Web UI
Locates files and folders on local storage using workspace, system index, and bounded recursive search
Displays local file references as attachment cards or inserts resolved paths into the message draft
Generates local image previews and computes file hashes for attachment deduplication
Saves pasted or unresolved content to a local .drops directory as a fallback
